firstPlayerRule: The player whose last meal was the healthiest or least healthy, as determined by all players, starts and takes the first-player marker.

sources.title: Consumption: Food and Choices — English rulebook

internalEvidence: The illustrated Kolossal booklet assigns the first-player marker by the group-judged last meal in setup. The booklet directs readers to Kolossal for variant rules, and its game identity matches inventory BGG 198517. SHA-256: 8c10db36c01967ec8b9fb7056b2d69631dbb6c4970e904a7f3b015a838de8d26. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22.
uncertainty: The group decides whether the healthiest or least healthy last meal qualifies; no tie procedure is supplied.
